name: Xoai cat
summary: Xoài cát Cần Giờ is the Hòa Lộc mango grown on this coast, round and yellow. It is cool-sweet, and the soil and the care make it different from the same variety elsewhere.
origin: Can Gio. Sài Gòn Giải Phóng, 17 Feb 2014. The industry department and the district were discussing it with muối and khô cá dứa as products to sell in the city.
seoDescription: Xoài cát Cần Giờ is a round, yellow Hòa Lộc mango, cool-sweet from this coast.
taste: Cool-sweet, round, and yellow, in the 17 Feb 2014 story.
